scope: Static literal-command audit of implementation languages plus focused cleanup source review. No native commands or process termination executed. Constructed/indirect commands require call-site review; a literal scan is not a complete behavioral proof.

findings.judgment: A libc::kill primitive exists; its documented contract requires incarnation checks by callers. This scan alone does not establish every caller is safe.
display-mode-hold is a Child returned by the harness spawn; kill/wait target that specific created Child.
KeepAwake owns the Child returned from spawning caffeinate and kills/waits that Child.
Cleanup records exclusive directory device/inode and successful installation record; failed acquisition never calls uninstall. The focused test uses disposable real installer fixtures.
